title: Enquiries
description: Messages and viewing requests from people interested in your listings. Reply here and it reaches them in LINE.

awaiting.title: You have answered everyone
awaiting.description: New messages and viewing requests show up here, and you are told in LINE.

open.title: No enquiries yet
open.description: Listings with full photos, a clear price and viewing times tend to get questions sooner.

closed.title: Nothing closed yet
closed.description: Enquiries you win or close move here.

prospect.title: About the prospect
prospect.lineYes: Your replies reach them in LINE

thread.title: Messages
thread.hint: Your messages reach the prospect in LINE. Never ask for money before a viewing.
thread.closed: This enquiry is closed; no more messages.

viewings.title: Viewings
viewings.empty: No viewings yet. When the prospect picks one of your viewing times, it shows up here.
viewings.confirmBody: The prospect gets a confirmation in LINE, and both of you are reminded before the time.
viewings.declineHint: Give a short reason or suggest another time. The prospect reads this in LINE.
viewings.outcomeTitle: How did the viewing on {date} go?
viewings.viewedBody: The prospect came to the viewing. The enquiry becomes “Viewed”.

notes.title: Your notes
notes.hint: Only you see these, never the prospect.

state.title: Status
state.hint: Keep track of where each prospect is.
state.wonBody: The enquiry closes and any pending viewing is cancelled.
state.lostHint: The reason helps you see what to improve. The prospect never sees it.

lease.title: Draft a lease for {name}
lease.body: Rent, deposit, advance and term come from the listing; the start is the prospect's move-in date. You can edit it before sending it to sign. When the lease takes effect the listing closes and the other prospects get a thank-you message in LINE.
